name: Laboratory Incandescent Bulb & Socket
semanticDescription: Laboratory incandescent electric lamp mounted in a molded black Bakelite socket on a studio slate plinth with dual knurled brass binding posts. Paired with a longitudinal cutaway revealing the tungsten filament, argon gas envelope, and internal conduction path illustrating Joule's heating law (H = I^2 R t) for CBSE Class 10 science.

collections.name: Bulb_Full
collections.description: Complete laboratory bench lamp in molded socket on slate plinth with twin brass binding posts, threaded Edison base, and optical clear glass envelope.

collections.name: Bulb_Section
collections.description: Cutaway glass envelope showing incandescent glowing tungsten filament, inert gas fill, complete internal conduction circuit loop, and forward-tilted educational plaque.
